## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`fix:`, `feature:`, `enhancement:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`), in English
- [ ] The checks in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Quartel-Enterprise/blitz-split-client/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#making-a-change) pass
- [ ] New logic in `core/*` or `feature/*` has unit tests
- [ ] Every new string is translated in every language the app has, on each platform
- [ ] The area's product doc under `docs/product/` is updated, if the behavior changed
- [ ] A release notes fragment is added, if people will notice the change
